name: addAction
signature: StelAction* addAction(QString id, QString groupId, QString text, QObject target, const char* slot, QString shortcut, QString altShortcut, bool global)
description: Creates and registers a new StelAction connected to an object property or slot. The action can be triggered via shortcuts, buttons, or scripting, and automatically appears in the hotkey configuration dialog.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique global identifier for the action (e.g., 'actionShow_Planets')

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Group identifier for organizing actions in UI (e.g., 'Display Options')

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Short human-readable description in English (will be translated automatically)

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The QObject the action is linked to (usually a module manager like SolarSystem or LandscapeMgr)

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: Slot name (e.g., 'setFlagPlanets(bool)') or property name. Use 'func()' for non-checkable actions, 'func(bool)' or property name for checkable actions

parameters.name: shortcut
parameters.description: Default shortcut/key combination (e.g., 'P', 'Ctrl+S', 'Shift+F5')

parameters.name: altShortcut
parameters.description: Alternative shortcut/key combination

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: If true, action works even when the main view doesn't have focus

returnDescription: Pointer to the created StelAction object

name: addAction
signature: StelAction* addAction(QString id, QString groupId, QString text, QObject context, std::function<void()> lambda, QString shortcut, QString altShortcut, bool global)
description: Creates and registers a new StelAction with a lambda function. The lambda will be executed when the action is triggered. Useful for simple actions that don't require dedicated slots.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique global identifier for the action

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Group identifier for organizing actions

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Short human-readable description

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Context object for the lambda; when deleted, the lambda won't be called

parameters.name: lambda
parameters.description: Lambda function to execute when the action is triggered

parameters.name: shortcut
parameters.description: Default shortcut/key combination

parameters.name: altShortcut
parameters.description: Alternative shortcut

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: If true, action works even without focus

returnDescription: Pointer to the created StelAction object

compatibility.notes: Requires C++11 or later for lambda support

name: findAction
description: Finds and returns a registered StelAction by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Action identifier (e.g., 'actionShow_Planets')

returnDescription: Pointer to StelAction, or null if not found

name: findActionFromShortcut
description: Finds and returns a StelAction associated with a specific keyboard shortcut. Returns the first matching action if found.

parameters.name: shortcut
parameters.description: Keyboard shortcut string (e.g., 'P', 'Ctrl+S')

returnDescription: Pointer to StelAction, or null if not found

name: pushKey
description: Processes a key press to trigger matching actions. Used internally by Stellarium's input handling system. Returns true if an action was triggered.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Qt key code for the pressed key (e.g., Qt.Key_P)

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: If true, only consider global actions

returnDescription: true if an action was triggered, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Internal use, but can be called from scripts for simulation

example:
// Simulate pressing 'P' key (show planets)
StelActionMgr.pushKey(80); // 80 is ASCII for 'P'

name: getGroupList
description: Returns a list of all action group identifiers. Groups are used to organize actions in UI like the Shortcuts Dialog.

name: getActionList
description: Returns a list of all StelActions belonging to a specific group.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group identifier (e.g., 'Display Options', 'Tools')

returnDescription: List of StelAction pointers in the group

name: getActionList
description: Returns a list of all registered StelActions.
example:
var allActions = StelActionMgr.getActionList();
core.debug("Total actions: " + allActions.length);

name: getShortcutsList
description: Returns a list of all keyboard shortcuts currently assigned to actions.

name: saveShortcuts
description: Saves the current keyboard shortcut assignments to the configuration file (config.ini). Should be called after changing any shortcuts.

name: restoreDefaultShortcuts
description: Restores all keyboard shortcuts to their default values and saves the configuration.

name: restoreDefaultShortcut
description: Restores a specific action's keyboard shortcuts to their default values and saves the configuration.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Pointer to the StelAction to restore

name: setAllActionsEnabled
description: Enables or disables all actions globally. Used during shortcut editing to prevent triggering actions while configuring them.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable all actions, false to disable them

name: isCheckable
description: Returns whether the action is checkable (toggleable). Actions connected to boolean properties or boolean slots are checkable.
returnDescription: true if the action can be toggled (checked/unchecked)

name: isChecked
description: Returns the current state of the action (for checkable actions). For non-checkable actions, this will always return false.
returnDescription: Current checked state (true = on/checked, false = off/unchecked)

name: isGlobal
description: Returns whether the action is global (works even when the main Stellarium window doesn't have keyboard focus).
returnDescription: true if the action is global

name: setShortcut
description: Sets the primary keyboard shortcut for this action. The shortcut will be saved when saveShortcuts() is called.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Keyboard shortcut (e.g., 'Ctrl+S', 'Shift+F5', 'P', '')

name: setAltShortcut
description: Sets the alternative keyboard shortcut for this action. The shortcut will be saved when saveShortcuts() is called.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Alternative keyboard shortcut (e.g., 'P', 'Ctrl+Alt+S')

name: matches
description: Checks how well a key sequence matches this action's shortcuts. Returns NoMatch, PartialMatch, or ExactMatch.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: Key sequence to check against

name: getId
description: Returns the unique identifier of this action.
example:
var action = StelActionMgr.findAction("actionShow_Planets");
core.debug("Action ID: " + action.getId());

name: getGroup
description: Returns the group identifier of this action (used for organization in UI).
example:
var action = StelActionMgr.findAction("actionShow_Planets");
core.debug("Action group: " + action.getGroup());

name: getShortcut
description: Returns the primary keyboard shortcut for this action.

name: getAltShortcut
description: Returns the alternative keyboard shortcut for this action.

name: getText
description: Returns the translated (localized) display text for this action.
example:
var action = StelActionMgr.findAction("actionShow_Planets");
core.debug("Action label: " + action.getText());

name: setText
description: Sets the display text for this action. The text will be translated automatically.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: English text for the action

example:
var action = StelActionMgr.findAction("actionCustom");
action.setText("My Custom Action");

name: setChecked
description: Sets the checked state of a checkable action. For non-checkable actions, this will crash - use isCheckable() first.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: true to check/activate, false to uncheck/deactivate

name: trigger
description: Triggers the action. For checkable actions, this toggles the state; for non-checkable actions, it calls the connected slot.

name: toggle
description: Toggles the state of a checkable action (on → off or off → on). For non-checkable actions, this will crash - use isCheckable() first.
